evidence_source.method: New offline CUDA inference twice; separate host evaluation after both containers exited.

git.working_tree: uncommitted S2 completion at inference freeze

runtime.execution_note: Two independent fresh model workers ran concurrently on the same GTX 1650; observed VRAM snapshot 2397 MiB, not measured peak. Timings are not a controlled hardware benchmark.
runtime.cache_note: Catalog/facts cache reused from prior checkpoints; OS cache/host load uncontrolled.

quality.wiring_before_model: 17/17 synthetic; fixed plans, not LLM acceptance

metric_definitions.runtime_behavior_matches: Scope/fallback conformance; expected abstain is still 0 evaluator points.
metric_definitions.percentages: Displayed to two decimal places; native answers preserve exact JSON numeric tokens.
metric_definitions.repeats: Two repeats of the same questions, not twice as many independent samples.

selection_policy.partition: common dev in both frozen protocols
selection_policy.exposure_note: 13 S1 and 8 growth values previously reported; 14 AOV/cancellation dev questions locked by wording before first inference/new gold. After the operand-binding checkpoint, all 35 native gold values have been scored before the final per-window grammar check. Historical EDA exposure exists; this is dev regression/engineering acceptance, not a blind holdout.

scope: One whole-business revenue/order_count total per question on verified CSV order-line or order-header count shapes.

limitations: S1 remains restricted to enabled shapes; header revenue, multi-sheet and raw JOIN not supported.
Native S2 evidence: one business, 8 growth plus 7 AOV and 7 cancellation dev questions; no representative PA estimate.
Group share and weekday/daily averages verified synthetically, not numeric native acceptance on other source families.
Runtime grammar and rule parser are finite; grammar binds recognized operand roles and periods before generation, not unrestricted LLM planning; arbitrary wording/overrides are not certified.
Zero/negative denominator and rounding half ties without authority abstain; AOV half-up is explicit.
Current LLM acceptance on CUDA GTX 1650 only; CPU, Blackwell and official evaluator equivalence not certified.
Historical EDA exposure exists; this is not a blind holdout.
